notablePrerequisites: Clever Conjurer and Kiora's Follower do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Clever Conjurer triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Clever Conjurer.
Kiora's Follower triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Repeat.
